title: Celebrating the 40-year milestone: NF-kB in oncoimmunity.
one_liner_zh: 综述NF-kB在肿瘤免疫中的信号通路与靶向治疗，仅提及AI整合前景，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Since its discovery by Dr. David Baltimore nearly 40 years ago, and in light of his recent passing, NF-kappaB has once again come into sharp focus as a central regulator of diverse cellular processes, including immune responses, inflammation, and cell survival. Its dysregulation is implicated in a wide range of human diseases, with mounting evidence highlighting its pivotal role in cancer and oncoimmunity. This review provides an integrated overview of NF-kappaB family members and their canonical and noncanonical signaling pathways, emphasizing how context-dependent activation orchestrates complex cellular outcomes. Within the tumor microenvironment (TME), NF-kappaB regulates crosstalk among cancer cells, immune subsets, and stromal components, promoting proliferation, metastasis, and immune evasion. We summarize FDA-approved and orphan-designated drugs targeting NF-kappaB, along with emerging therapeutics in clinical and preclinical development. Innovative strategies, including tumor-targeted delivery, immune checkpoint combination, nanocatalytic, and epigenetic modulation, are redefining NF-kappaB-directed therapy. Looking ahead, future efforts should focus on understanding context-specific NF-kappaB signaling, optimizing combination therapies, improving drug delivery and bioavailability, and identifying predictive biomarkers for patient stratification. Moreover, the emerging integration of artificial intelligence holds promise to accelerate discovery and personalize NF-kappaB-targeted therapies. Collectively, FDA-approved agents, experimental compounds, and novel strategies underscore NF-kappaB modulation as a versatile and promising avenue for cancer and immune disease therapy.
abstract_zh: 自David Baltimore博士近40年前发现NF-kappaB以来，鉴于其最近逝世，NF-kappaB再次成为焦点，作为多种细胞过程的核心调节因子，包括免疫反应、炎症和细胞存活。其失调与多种人类疾病相关，越来越多的证据强调其在癌症和肿瘤免疫中的关键作用。本综述对NF-kappaB家族成员及其经典和非经典信号通路进行了综合概述，强调上下文依赖性激活如何协调复杂的细胞结果。在肿瘤微环境（TME）中，NF-kappaB调节癌细胞、免疫亚群和基质成分之间的串扰，促进增殖、转移和免疫逃逸。我们总结了针对NF-kappaB的FDA批准和孤儿药指定药物，以及临床和临床前开发中的新兴疗法。创新策略，包括肿瘤靶向递送、免疫检查点联合、纳米催化和表观遗传调节，正在重新定义NF-kappaB导向治疗。展望未来，应重点关注理解上下文特异性NF-kappaB信号传导、优化联合疗法、改善药物递送和生物利用度，以及识别用于患者分层的预测性生物标志物。此外，人工智能的新兴整合有望加速发现并个性化NF-kappaB靶向治疗。总体而言，FDA批准的药物、实验化合物和新策略强调了NF-kappaB调节作为癌症和免疫疾病治疗的多功能且有前景的途径。
